d: Former US President Barack Obama has mocked Donald Trump over the White House renovation controversy, accusing his administration of responding to a Cheesecake Factory joke while ignoring allegations of corruption and rising costs. Speaking at a Georgia campaign rally, Obama backed Democratic candidates Jon Ossoff and Keisha Lance Bottoms ahead of the November 3, 2026 midterms, with inflation, healthcare and control of Congress shaping the campaign.
